heading: top-center
name: 內縮卡片＋置中標題＋方形圖片疊字網格
desc: 整個區塊是左右留邊、四角圓角的卡片；上方置中放標題組，下方是一列方形圖片項目，小標籤、標題與按鈕置中疊在圖片上。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊是卡片，左右兩側留邊，上下不留白、貼齊區塊的上下緣；四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）都做圓角；卡片的左右邊緣對齊頁面內容寬度，卡片有自己的底色。區塊上方置中放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字與按鈕，沒有時省略；標題組和下方網格之間留較大的空白。標題組下方是多個項目排成的網格，每列數量依內容而定，項目等寬等高、圖片同為方形；整組網格明顯窄於卡片內寬、置中，項目之間留較寬的間隔。每個項目是一張方形圖片，圖片中央疊放置中的標題（可多行），標題上方可放小標籤、下方可放按鈕，沒有時省略。
mobile: 卡片仍左右留邊、上下不留白、四個角都做圓角。標題組仍置中在上方；網格改為直向堆疊，每列一個項目，圖片仍為方形、約佔卡片內寬的大部分，小標籤、標題與按鈕仍置中疊在圖片中央。

en.name: Inset card + centered heading + grid of square images with overlaid text
en.desc: The whole section is a card with side margins and all four corners rounded; a centered heading group sits at the top, and below it is a row of square image items with a label, title and button centered on top of each image.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section is a card with margins on the left and right sides and no spacing at the top and bottom, flush with the top and bottom edges of the section; all four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) are rounded corners; the left and right edges of the card align with the page content width, and the card has its own background color. Place the heading group at the top, centered. The heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description and button below; omit them when there is no content. A larger space separates the heading group from the grid below. Below the heading group is a grid of multiple items, with the number per row depending on the content; items are equal in width and height, and all images are square. The whole grid is noticeably narrower than the card's inner width and centered, with wide gaps between items. Each item is a single square image with a centered title (may wrap to multiple lines) overlaid in the middle of the image, optionally with a label above the title and a button below it; omit them when there is no content.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The card keeps its left and right margins, no spacing at the top and bottom, and all four rounded corners. The heading group stays centered at the top; the grid becomes a vertical stack with one item per row, the images stay square and take up most of the card's inner width, and the label, title and button stay centered on top of the middle of each image.
